messages:
maya: Heads up — scanner pipeline started failing after the service-account rotation last night. Trivy jobs error out on KMS decrypt and GHAS is spamming duplicate findings.

ops-ci-bot: [ALERT] scanner-job-881 failed: Trivy exit code 2; reason: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE (detected at 2026-03-19T22:04:08Z) :alarm_clock:

ben: @maya did we change the scanner SA or tighten the KMS key policy in infra-pr #842? I see a rolebinding change around 2026-03-19 03:12 UTC.

maya: yep, we rotated to `scanner-runner-sa@redwood.svc` and tightened kms key policy to principal list only. I intended to add the new SA ARN to the key but missed it. quick log snippet from the trivy job: 

```
2026-03-19T22:03:59Z ERROR main: failed to decrypt ciphertext: KMS:UserNotAuthorizedException: Access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
status code: 400, request id: 5a7c
\nscanner-connector: 403 forbidden when calling GHAS connector: missing signature
```

maya: Also noticed suppression hits don't match because the SA identity string changed, so old suppressions didn't apply and GHAS created duplicates. Not huge volume but noisy.

jordan: Two quick options: (1) add the new service account principal to the KMS key policy (fast), or (2) create a separate key alias for scanner and update the connector config to use it (safer for rotation). I can patch the policy if you want me to.

sophia: fyi suppression mapping lives in `ops-scanner/suppressions.yaml` and we match on the `principal` field. If the SA canonical name changed the matcher fails and we re-ingest old CVEs as new. Example entry we currently have: 

```
- id: "CVE-2024-1234"
  reason: "low-risk dev dependency"
  principal: "k8s:serviceaccount:infra:scanner-old-sa"
  expires: "2026-09-01"
```

sophia: You'll need to update that to `k8s:serviceaccount:infra:scanner-runner-sa` or use a wildcard prefix like `k8s:serviceaccount:infra:scanner*` for a short window.

ben: Also check GHAS webhook secrets — if the connector restarted with a different SA identity it may have re-registered and GHAS sent duplicates. We saw this pattern when the webhook consumer reauths.

maya: plan: I'll add the SA principal to the key policy now and update suppressions.yaml to canonical name + wildcard fallback. After that I'll trigger a re-run of the failed jobs. Rolling change so minimal blast radius. ETA 30m. Anyone object?

jordan: no objections, go for it. I can review the KMS policy change before you apply.

ops-ci-bot: queued job re-run request (scanner-backfill-882) will trigger after policy update.

maya: thanks — will post when done and paste the exact commands. :white_check_mark:
